observed.symptom: planner model call did not return within the 300 s provider timeout; LiteLLM emitted repeated feedback banners at timeout intervals and retried under num_retries=3; no stage_end or summary was produced
observed.endpoint_health_control: GET /v1/models returned HTTP 200 in ~1.1 s and listed DeepSeek-V4-Flash, so DNS, TLS, and the stored key are valid; the delay is generation latency, not auth or reachability

disposition: Pre-dataset aborted pilot. It produced no raw.jsonl record and is not counted as a scheduled-key attempt in the 30-key completeness audit; it is retained as operational evidence and reported separately. The batch was restarted under v2 with ATHENA_MAX_LLM_CALLS=40, ATHENA_LLM_TIMEOUT_S=900 and ATHENA_A2A_TIMEOUT_S=1200. No synthetic record was inserted and no scoring rule was changed.
reason_for_abort: Independent audit findings 2 and 3: the historical Groq diagnostic cap of 12 must not truncate a full hierarchical run (documented policy is 40), and the 300 s provider timeout was demonstrably too short for AMD.
